question: Should OpenClaw retain the proposed all-or-nothing parser for 2026.7.2 beta envelope snapshots while accepting standard DSSE envelopes, and what release/support event retires that fallback?
rationale: The implementation makes a compatibility bridge at the signed plugin-catalog trust boundary; tests and producer-to-consumer proof establish interoperability, but they cannot choose the supported upgrade window or long-term accepted-input policy.

options.title: Approve bounded beta bridge
options.body: Accept standard DSSE now and retain the isolated legacy parser only for the documented 2026.7.2 beta snapshots until an owner-defined retirement release or migration event.

options.title: Require standard-only parsing
options.body: Remove the legacy parser before merge and require any beta snapshot upgrade to regenerate or migrate through an explicit supported path.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded beta bridge
recommendation.body: Accept standard DSSE now and retain the isolated legacy parser only for the documented 2026.7.2 beta snapshots until an owner-defined retirement release or migration event.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor most closely to the proposed envelope bridge and dependent feed stack; a repository owner still needs to make the policy decision.
